# Inspection checklist for sample points

Use this checklist when you visit a sample point. Check that the sample bottle is clean, the tap is flushed and the label is filled in before you take a sample. For reference, these are the rules we work to.

- Chlorine residual: between 0.2 and 0.5 mg/L.
- Turbidity: below 1 NTU.

## Sampling
- Weekly samples at 40 monitoring points.
- Compliance in 2024: 99.2% of samples within limits.

Write your name and the time on the form and hand the samples to the laboratory driver before noon.
